decisions.decision: Custom 50-line Markdown renderer for Help Center (Pattern 62) instead of react-native-markdown-display dep
decisions.rationale: Help content uses a tiny subset (`**`, `_`, `` ` ``, `-`, `\d+.`). Custom parser avoids dep churn, New-Arch compatibility risk, STACK.md edits. Defensive fallthrough on unmatched delimiters keeps malformed source from blanking lines.

Pattern 64. Persisting risks staleness against backend /me updates. Two write-paths (signInWithGoogle return + ProfileScreen /me fetch) keep it self-healing. Existing-session users populate by visiting Profile once.

decisions.decision: Gender enum strings enforced client-side only at MVP — no backend migration
decisions.rationale: User-supplied verbatim spec: ['Male', 'Female', "Don't want to disclose"]. Backend users.gender is text + UserPatchSchema accepts any string up to 40 chars; constraining at the UI is sufficient. Adding new values means extending GENDER_OPTIONS const in ProfileScreen.tsx (single source of truth).

decisions.decision: Pattern 65 — surgical commit when working tree carries intentionally-uncommitted backlog
decisions.rationale: Anti-pattern recorded in quick-260510-005 SUMMARY: blanket `git add <file>` on SignupScreen.tsx silently picked up Phase 3 W1 cosmetic-backlog content. Protocol: save-cosmetic-version → git checkout HEAD -- file → reapply only my edits → stage → commit → restore-cosmetic-version. Apply this protocol to ALL future quick tasks that touch SignupScreen.tsx, Text.tsx, or any file later marked as cosmetic-backlog.
